text:
Maya: FYI eviction telemetry cost spiked; proposal: deterministic sampling of evict events to cut volume.

Kevin: Deterministic per-prefix is essential so metrics remain comparable. simplest: hash(prefix) % 100 < pct.

Srini: Use sample bands to limit cardinality (s0=100%, s1=10%, s2=1%). attach band tag not raw pct.

Jess: Exempt heavy hitters via small top-k sketch so we don't miss regressions.

Ava: Ops concern: sampling can delay detection of eviction storms. add bypass rule: if tenant eviction rate > THRESH, force full telemetry for short window.

Kevin: Implementation note: keep sampler in the hot path cheap, compute hash once, check band table, emit tag.

Maya: Rollout plan: phase1 10% global deterministic sample + parity full-events to blobstore for 48h; phase2 enable top-k exemption; phase3 adaptive per-tenant bands. Canary 5% hosts per phase.

Jess: Also run replay evals: feed historical full telemetry through sampler to estimate false-negative risk before each ramp.

Srini: Metrics to add: sampled_rate_by_band, and a small bypass counter. Use coarse tenant shard tag to reduce cardinality.

Ava: Ops will run A/B on alerts for 72h and prepare rollback playbook.

Maya: Action items:
- Kevin: prototype sampler + PR with config flag telemetry.eviction.sampling
- Srini: band enum + cardinality plan
- Jess: top-k sketch plan + replay eval harness
- Ava: alert A/B plan and runbook

evict-bot: [alert] tenant-821 eviction wave (120r/s)  seen in parity logs; sampled stream would have missed without bypass.

Maya: Keep parity until phase2 validated. If replay shows <0.5% missed critical events we can relax sample band.

Kevin: I'll post a draft in eng-runtime later today.

Maya: Thanks — scheduling a short rollout window once PR lands.
